config.label: Handle, DID, or email of the Bluesky account post search runs as
config.description: Handle, DID, or email of the Bluesky account post search runs as. Optional: without it and BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD, bsky_search_posts is not offered, since Bluesky refuses search without a signed-in account. Use a dedicated account — search leaves out posts from accounts in a block relationship with it.

config.label: App password for BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER (a standard, non-privileged one — Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords)
config.description: App password for BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER (a standard, non-privileged one — Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords). Optional; required together with BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER to enable bsky_search_posts.
